Package com.codeup.novabook.repo.impl

Class LoanRepositoryImpl

java.lang.Object
com.codeup.novabook.repo.impl.LoanRepositoryImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
IGeneralRepository<Loan,Integer>, ILoanRepository
public class LoanRepositoryImpl extends Object implements ILoanRepository
JDBC implementation of the ILoanRepository interface.

This repository manages Loan entities with comprehensive transaction support for the library's lending operations. Handles loan lifecycle, overdue tracking, and fine calculations. Simplified database operations with JdbcTemplateLight.

Key Features:

  • Loan lifecycle management (create, active, return, overdue)
  • Overdue loans tracking for CSV export
  • Member loan history and restrictions
  • Date range queries for reporting
  • Active loan validation to prevent duplicate loans

Transaction Support:

This repository is designed to work within transactional contexts managed by the service layer. Stock operations should be coordinated with IBookRepository within transactions.
